name: Dan Jurafsky

affiliations.role: Professor of Linguistics and Computer Science

bio: Dan Jurafsky is a Professor of Linguistics and Computer Science at Stanford University, where they have taught since 2003. Their research covers computational linguistics and natural language processing. Jurafsky co-wrote the textbook Speech and Language Processing with James H. Martin and received a MacArthur Fellowship in 2002.
known_for: Computational linguistics of language and society
